statusOverview.activityAria: Gateway service activity over the last 60 minutes
statusOverview.activityBody: The activity variant places the label, fixed-width ticks and summary in one row, moving the rail below on narrow containers. Each tick retains its full hit area and keyboard support. Full-height gray ticks indicate idle or empty buckets; shorter ticks indicate unknown status. Supply precise meanings through ariaLabel / tooltip. The default card variant remains unchanged.
statusOverview.p8: card is the default framed status card; activity is a frameless compact service row with fine ticks.
statusOverview.p9: Optional activity-row controls or results replacing the summary column. Inline in wide containers and stacked in narrow ones. Ignored in card mode.
statusOverview.description: A compact, inspectable status rail for equal-duration availability history or current node snapshots.
statusOverview.dataBoundaryBody: Timeline items represent equal-duration contiguous buckets in one start-to-end range. Normalize irregular samples and calculate availability in the consuming feature before rendering.
statusOverview.keyboard: Focus the rail once, then use Arrow keys, Home, End, Page Up, and Page Down to inspect segments. Escape closes the shared tooltip.
statusOverview.errorMessage: Could not load current node status.
statusOverview.p0: Accessible name for the complete status region and its single keyboard rail.
statusOverview.p1: Primary label displayed at the upper left. In activity mode, pass null and omit rangeLabel to let the rail fill the first row, with results below.
statusOverview.p2: Optional time-range or supporting label beside the primary label.
statusOverview.p3: Caller-computed summary label, value, and semantic status tone.
statusOverview.p4: Timeline with a shared epoch range and equal-duration buckets, or an ordered current-node snapshot.
statusOverview.p5: Localized content rendered whenever the active data mode has no items.
statusOverview.p6: Controls data availability and loading presentation.
statusOverview.p7: Required localized explanation for stale, unavailable, and error states.
